title: refactor(desktop): drop the Recent row from the Record page
body:
## What

Removes the Recent row (four recent recording thumbnails) from the Record page. Owner decision: the page is already full.

## Removed

- `RecentRecordings` and `useRecentRecordings` (`features/recording/components/recent-recordings.tsx`) and its CSS module
- The usage in `record-page.tsx` and the matching test in `record-page.test.tsx`
- i18n keys `record.recent` and `record.recentMeta` in en and es (no other reader; checked with grep)
- Doc lines saying the Record page lists recent recordings (capture modes spec, capture metadata backlog doc)

## Stays

- The Recent row on the Screenshots page (`recent-screenshots.tsx` and its styles), because that page would be empty otherwise
- `RecordingCaptureTag`, still used by the library cards

## Verification

- `check-types:web` and `check-types:node`: clean
- `oxlint`: 0 errors (17 pre-existing warnings)
- `vitest run`: 280 files, 2552 tests pass. One earlier run had a single unrelated failure (a space-key test); the two reruns were green.
